test.create_query: CREATE TABLE map_repeated_keys ENGINE = Memory AS SELECT intDiv(number, 250) AS g, map('c1', number % 100, 'c5', (number + 1) % 100, 'c10', (number + 2) % 100, 'c50', (number + 3) % 100, 'c100', (number + 4) % 100, 'c500', (number + 5) % 100) AS m FROM numbers(5000000)
test.query: SELECT sumMap(m) FROM map_repeated_keys FORMAT Null
SELECT g, sumMap(m) FROM map_repeated_keys GROUP BY g FORMAT Null
SELECT number % 100000 AS g, sumMap(map(leftPad(toString(intDiv(number, 100000)), 28, 'k'), 1)) FROM numbers(1000000) GROUP BY g FORMAT Null
SELECT sumMap(map(leftPad(toString(number), 23, 'x'), 1)) FROM numbers(700000) FORMAT Null
